title: sticherus cundinamarcensis
intro: Sticherus cundinamarcensis, commonly known as the "Cundinamarca Rasp Fern", is a species of fern native to South America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant to protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Sticherus cundinamarcensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
